neighbours.label: statements of algebra / number-theory results in mathematical prose (unique factorization, linear maps, vector spaces): function and quantifier words inside the theorem statement
fire: The unique factorization theorem states that every positive integer greater than one is a product of primes in exactly one way.
Therefore any linear transformation of the plane can be represented as a two-by-two matrix once a basis is chosen.
The fundamental theorem of algebra states that every nonconstant polynomial with complex coefficients has at least one complex root.
Hence any finite abelian group can be written as a direct sum of cyclic groups of prime power order.
Euclid's lemma states that if a prime divides a product of two integers, then it divides at least one of them.
Therefore any symmetric real matrix can be diagonalized by an orthogonal change of basis.
The Chinese remainder theorem states that a system of congruences with coprime moduli has a unique solution modulo their product.
It follows that any polynomial over a field can be factored uniquely as a product of irreducible polynomials.
quiet: The company handbook states that every new employee older than eighteen is entitled to paid leave in exactly one block.
Therefore any rental property in the district can be registered as a holiday home once a permit is granted.
The founding charter of the club states that every member with voting rights has at least one seat at the table.
Hence any retired teacher in the county can be hired as a substitute for classes of any age group.
The tenancy agreement states that if a tenant damages a wall or a window, then he pays for at least one repair.
Therefore any wooden kitchen table can be refinished by a patient amateur with sandpaper.
The weather service bulletin states that a band of storms with heavy rain has a clear path toward the coast.
It follows that any witness in a trial can be questioned separately by lawyers for both sides.

notes: weak, mostly gate-closed pole. Probe: 'fundamental theorem of arithmetic states that' 0.85, 'Therefore any linear map … as a matrix' 0.39, but Pythagoras and rank-nullity sentences stayed under 0.2.
